日表 `ads_channel_promotion_summary_d` 可以这么理解：

### 一行是啥
**某一天 × 某个 App × 某个渠道码** 的一条推广汇总。

### 怎么算出来的
不是自己从明细重算，而是 **把下面三张日表按「App + 渠道」拼在一起**：

| 来源 | 大致贡献 |
|------|----------|
| 扣量表 `dws_app_channel_deduction_d` | 下载、安装、注册、充值等（带扣量） |
| 渠道汇总 `dws_app_channel_summary_d` | 落地页展示/点击、独立 IP 点击 |
| 留存表 `dws_app_channel_retention_d` | 昨日新增、次日留存人数 |

三张表用 **FULL JOIN**：有一边有数就会留下，缺的字段补 0。

### 字段各是啥意思（人话）

- **落地页**：展示数、点击数、独立 IP 点击（IP 去重）
- **下载 / 安装**：下载数、安装数（另有扣量版）
- **new_user**：注释写的是 **注册人数**（不是「活跃」）
- **充值**：充值人数、充值金额、金币充值金额（另有扣量版）
- **last_day_new_user_num**：昨日新增用户数  
- **last_day_retention_num**：次日留存用户数（昨天新增里，今天还来的人）

有一批字段分两套：**未扣量** 和 **扣量**。两套口径不一样，不能混着对。

需求里把 `new_user` 当成「新增活跃」、把 `last_day_retention_num` 拿去滚周月次留。

# 用法：bash .cursor/scripts/enable-automation-as-authority-new-mac.sh
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.." && pwd)"
DOMAIN="gui/$(id -u)"
DISABLED="$HOME/Library/LaunchAgents/disabled-on-new-mac"
AUTH_FILE="$HOME/.dc-platform/memory/work-log/AUTHORITY_HOST"
HOST_ENV="$HOME/.dc-platform/memory/.env.host"
STATE_DIR="$HOME/Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/state"
LOG_DIR="$HOME/.dc-platform/logs"
mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR" "$HOME/Library/LaunchAgents" "$STATE_DIR"

echo "=== 1) 权威主机 → new-mac ==="
cat >"$AUTH_FILE" <<'EOF'
# 正式日报权威主机（一行，勿加引号）
# 2026-09-27：自动化迁至 new-mac；old-mac 暂停
new-mac
EOF
printf '%s\n' 'export WORKLOG_HOST_ID=new-mac' >"$HOST_ENV"
echo "  AUTHORITY_HOST=new-mac  WORKLOG_HOST_ID=new-mac"

echo "=== 2) 刷新 agent-bus 部署并启动 ==="
bash "$ROOT/.cursor/scripts/sync-agent-bus-deploy.sh" || bash "$ROOT/.cursor/scripts/install-agent-bus-launchd.sh"
launchctl kickstart -k "$DOMAIN/com.youchu.agent-bus-poller" 2>/dev/null \
  || launchctl bootstrap "$DOMAIN" "$HOME/Library/LaunchAgents/com.youchu.agent-bus-poller.plist" 2>/dev/null \
  || true

echo "=== 3) 启动 TG bot（仅 com.dc.tgbot-daemon，避免双 plist） ==="
TGBOT_APP="$HOME/Library/Application Support/tgbot-dc/scripts"
# 同步关键脚本到 App Support（若源更新）
if [[ -d "$ROOT/omdb/tgbot" ]]; then
  mkdir -p "$TGBOT_APP"
  for f in start_daemon.sh start.sh stop.sh restart.sh daemon_check.sh _env.sh heartbeat_util.sh; do
    [[ -f "$ROOT/omdb/tgbot/$f" ]] && cp "$ROOT/omdb/tgbot/$f" "$TGBOT_APP/$f" && chmod +x "$TGBOT_APP/$f"
  done
  # install_launchd 副本在 App Support 或 omdb
  if [[ -f "$TGBOT_APP/install_launchd.sh" ]]; then
    bash "$TGBOT_APP/install_launchd.sh"
  elif [[ -f "$ROOT/omdb/tgbot/scripts/install_launchd.sh" ]]; then
    # ensure plist points to App Support launcher
    bash "$ROOT/omdb/tgbot/scripts/install_launchd.sh" 2>/dev/null || true

      launchctl kickstart -k "$DOMAIN/com.dc.tgbot-daemon" 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
  fi

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# 日报定时唤醒（权威机）：冲刺同步 + 写入 wake_feed，供 IDE 主会话接住写稿并推送
set -euo pipefail

TZ=Asia/Shanghai
export TZ
STATE_DIR="${AGENT_BUS_STATE_DIR:-$HOME/Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/state}"
LOG="$STATE_DIR/daily-report-wake.log"
WAKE="$STATE_DIR/wake_feed.log"
AUTH_FILE="$HOME/.dc-platform/memory/work-log/AUTHORITY_HOST"
HOST_ENV="$HOME/.dc-platform/memory/.env.host"
MARKER="$HOME/.dc-platform/memory/work-log/reports/.daily_report_dm_posted.json"
mkdir -p "$STATE_DIR"

_host_id() {
  if [[ -n "${WORKLOG_HOST_ID:-}" ]]; then echo "$WORKLOG_HOST_ID"; return; fi
  if [[ -f "$HOST_ENV" ]]; then
    # shellcheck disable=SC1090
    source "$HOST_ENV" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
  echo "${WORKLOG_HOST_ID:-unknown}"
}

_authority() {
  if [[ -n "${WORKLOG_AUTHORITY_HOST:-}" ]]; then echo "$WORKLOG_AUTHORITY_HOST"; return; fi
  if [[ -f "$AUTH_FILE" ]]; then
    while IFS= read -r line; do
      line="${line%%#*}"
      line="$(echo "$line" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
      [[ -n "$line" ]] && { echo "$line"; return; }
    done <"$AUTH_FILE"
  fi
  echo "new-mac"
}

{
  echo "[$(date '+%F %T')] daily-report-wake start"
  host="$(_host_id)"
  auth="$(_authority)"
  if [[ "$host" != "$auth" ]]; then
    echo "skip: host=$host authority=$auth"
    exit 0
  fi
  # 周日不推
  dow="$(date '+%u')" # 1=Mon … 7=Sun
  if [[ "$dow" == "7" ]]; then
    echo "skip: Sunday"
    exit 0
  fi
  day="$(date '+%Y-%m-%d')"
  if [[ -f "$MARKER" ]] && python3 -c "import json,sys; m=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); sys.exit(0 if sys.argv[2] in m else 1)" "$MARKER" "$day" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "skip: already posted $day"
    exit 0
  fi
  bash "$HOME/.dc-platform/scripts/prepare_daily_report_sync.sh" "$day" || true
  payload="$(python3 -c "import json; print(json.dumps({'date':'''$day''','prompt':'AGENT_LOOP_WAKE_DAILY_REPORT：写今日日报并推送 TG 私聊（post_daily_report_to_dm.py）。先双机 sync，今日结果只写已完成。'},ensure_ascii=False))")"
  echo "AGENT_LOOP_WAKE_DAILY_REPORT $payload" >>"$WAKE"
  echo "wrote wake for $day"
} >>"$LOG" 2>&1

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# 日报兜底（权威机，wake 后 +15min）：有稿未推则直推；无稿再写一条 wake
set -euo pipefail

TZ=Asia/Shanghai
export TZ
STATE_DIR="${AGENT_BUS_STATE_DIR:-$HOME/Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/state}"
LOG="$STATE_DIR/daily-report-fallback.log"
WAKE="$STATE_DIR/wake_feed.log"
AUTH_FILE="$HOME/.dc-platform/memory/work-log/AUTHORITY_HOST"
HOST_ENV="$HOME/.dc-platform/memory/.env.host"
REPORTS="$HOME/.dc-platform/memory/work-log/reports"
POST_PY="$HOME/.dc-platform/memory/scripts/post_daily_report_to_dm.py"
mkdir -p "$STATE_DIR"

_host_id() {
  if [[ -n "${WORKLOG_HOST_ID:-}" ]]; then echo "$WORKLOG_HOST_ID"; return; fi
  if [[ -f "$HOST_ENV" ]]; then
    # shellcheck disable=SC1090
    source "$HOST_ENV" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
  echo "${WORKLOG_HOST_ID:-unknown}"
}

_authority() {
  if [[ -n "${WORKLOG_AUTHORITY_HOST:-}" ]]; then echo "$WORKLOG_AUTHORITY_HOST"; return; fi
  if [[ -f "$AUTH_FILE" ]]; then
    while IFS= read -r line; do
      [[ "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue
      line="$(echo "$line" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
      [[ -n "$line" ]] && { echo "$line"; return; }
    done <"$AUTH_FILE"
  fi
  echo "new-mac"
}

{
  echo "[$(date '+%F %T')] daily-report-fallback start"
  host="$(_host_id)"
  auth="$(_authority)"
  if [[ "$host" != "$auth" ]]; then
    echo "skip: host=$host authority=$auth"
    exit 0
  fi
  dow="$(date '+%u')"
  if [[ "$dow" == "7" ]]; then
    echo "skip: Sunday"
    exit 0
  fi
  day="$(date '+%Y-%m-%d')"
  report=""
  for name in "${day}-日报.md" "日报-${day}.md"; do
    if [[ -f "$REPORTS/$name" ]] && [[ -s "$REPORTS/$name" ]]; then
      report="$REPORTS/$name"
      break
    fi
  done
  if [[ -n "$report" ]]; then
    echo "post existing $report"
    python3 "$POST_PY" --date "$day" --file "$report" --force || true
    exit 0
  fi
  echo "no report yet; re-wake"
  bash "$HOME/.dc-platform/scripts/prepare_daily_report_sync.sh" "$day" || true
  payload="$(python3 -c "import json; print(json.dumps({'date':'''$day''','prompt':'AGENT_LOOP_WAKE_DAILY_REPORT：兜底——写今日日报并推送 TG（post_daily_report_to_dm.py）。'},ensure_ascii=False))")"
  echo "AGENT_LOOP_WAKE_DAILY_REPORT $payload" >>"$WAKE"
} >>"$LOG" 2>&1
